tools.description: Run the free AI-visibility report for a website (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude coverage, competitor gaps, prioritized fixes). Requires the user's real email — the finished report is emailed there and a shareable report URL is returned. Takes up to ~10 minutes; set wait_seconds up to 50 to wait inline, or poll later with get_aeo_report_status. Never fill the company field.

competitor.description: Optional pinned competitor domain to compare.

competitors.description: Optional competitor domains to compare (max 5). The public report pins exactly one; send more only with an agency key.

anyOf.description: Short free-text vertical hint, e.g. 'medical aesthetics practice'. Same as {vertical_hint: '<text>'} on both the public and the agency-key path.

context.description: Optional context that scopes the report. A string is the vertical hint. A value that cannot be used is rejected with invalid_context and a reason, never silently dropped: 422 on the public path, 400 with an agency key (including a blank string or a hint over 256 characters).

customQuestions.description: Optional 5–20 exact questions, in order, replacing generated questions. Text and order are preserved verbatim; supplied questions are already approved. Omit, null, a blank string or [] to generate questions as before.

domain.description: Registrable domain or full URL to audit, e.g. example.com

email.description: The user's real work email (MX-validated; disposable domains rejected). The report is emailed here.

fresh.description: Force a fresh run instead of a cached report.

idempotency_key.description: 16-128 printable chars. Required for a trusted (agency-key) create so retries map to one job. May be sent as the Idempotency-Key HTTP header instead.

market.description: Optional market the report is measured in, as a city and region, e.g. 'Austin, TX'. Same as context.location.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait inline for completion (0-50). Default 0: returns the job to poll.

tools.name: run_aeo_report

tools.description: Poll a previously submitted AEO report job once. status is queued, preparing, needs_review or running (keep polling) or complete, partial or failed (terminal); state carries the phase and reason. When complete or partial, returns the structured report (per-engine breakdown with provenance, recommendations, coverage, methodology, the measured questions, competitor evidence, named share of voice), the shareable report_url, and a markdown_summary to read to the user.
tools.name: get_aeo_report_status
